description.value: Rainbow Suites is a rustic vacation rental condo sitting in the heart of Whistler Village, managed by Whistler Retreats & Property Management. Guests are a short walk from both the Whistler and Blackcomb gondolas and immediately surrounded by the village's restaurants, galleries, and shops. The property uses electronic door-code self-check-in with no on-site staff and no daily housekeeping.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (16 spaces) at 69m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is a sparse vacation rental listing page on whistlerretreats.com confirming Rainbow Suites is a self-check-in condo in Whistler Village managed by Whistler Retreats & Property Management; the listing page itself provides almost no amenity detail beyond location highlights. The policies page references underground parking and electronic door-code self-check-in but mentions no bike storage or bike handling whatsoever. Nearby evening food is confirmed by the events/activities page, which explicitly references 'more than a hundred bars and restaurants' in the surrounding village.
concerns: OSM tags this as tourism=hotel but it is a vacation rental condo operated by a third-party property management company (Whistler Retreats & Property Management), not a traditional staffed hotel.
Phone number used is the Whistler Retreats management company toll-free line; OSM record contains no phone number of its own.
Website URL was auto-discovered at medium confidence and is a listing page within a broader property management site, not a dedicated Rainbow Suites website.
Self-check-in via electronic door codes with no on-site staff mentioned — the 'Staff know the bike procedure' criterion may be structurally inapplicable to this property type.
No bike storage or any other cyclist-specific amenity information is present anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Rainbow Suites is a legitimate condo rental in a prime cycling-adjacent location, but the website contains no evidence for either required cyclist criterion; direct outreach to Whistler Retreats is needed to confirm secure bike storage and staff bike-handling capability before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Whistler Retreats manages at least eight other Whistler properties (Crystal Ridge, Glaciers Reach, Lake Placid Lodge, Marketplace Lodge, Snowberry, Stoney Creek Lagoons, Stoney Creek Sunpath, The Marquise) that may appear as separate OSM records; check for duplicates or portfolio-level outreach opportunity.
